info.title: portaliq demo data
info.description: Demo data covering every schema this app supplies, offered as the first step of the app's setup walkthrough. Generated from the schemas themselves, so every object satisfies the schema that will validate it.

x-openregister.description: Demo data for portaliq. NOT installed automatically — a mock register is imported on demand, from the setup walkthrough or `occ openregister:descriptors:list --app=portaliq --import=<slug>`.

portaliq.title: Portaliq Register (demo)
portaliq.description: Demo data for Portaliq Register. Generated from the register's own schemas — see hydra-gates/scripts/lib/generate_mock_register.py.

exampleDocument.title: Example Document
exampleDocument.description: A demo subject-scoped content object so the portal object reader is exercisable end-to-end. Carries subjectRef so PortalObjectReader can scope it. Replace with real, app-owned content schemas (procest ships supplierContract etc.).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject this document belongs to; the field PortalObjectReader scopes on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this document belongs to.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable title shown in the portal.

glossaryTerm.title: Glossary Term
glossaryTerm.description: One begrippenlijst entry, scoped to a portal (ADR-086 §5). Moves out of OpenCatalogi with the rest of the CMS. A renderer MAY auto-link occurrences of a term in page prose to its definition; that linking happens at render time and never alters the stored markdown.

definition.title: Definition
definition.example: Een verzoek om openbaarmaking van overheidsinformatie.

synonyms.title: Synonyms
synonyms.description: Alternative spellings or names, also auto-linked when auto-linking is enabled.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the definition comes from — a statute, a standard, or a published vocabulary.

relations.title: Related terms
relations.description: Other glossary terms on the SAME portal that this one relates to.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The portal this term belongs to. REQUIRED — a relation to a term on another portal is rejected.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: A navigation menu for one portal (ADR-086 §3). The shape is preserved EXACTLY as OpenCatalogi deploys it today — two levels, `order`/`name`/`link`/`icon`/`groups`/`hideBeforeLogin`/`hideAfterLogin` — so the handover needs no data migration across the ten live municipal deployments.

position.title: Position
position.description: Ordering of this menu relative to others on the same portal (a header menu versus a footer menu).

items.title: Items
items.description: Ordered menu items. Exactly two levels are allowed: an item may carry `items`, but a sub-item may not.

link.title: Link
link.description: Route or URL this item points at. An in-site route matches a page's `route`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional supporting text shown with the item.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon name from the shared semantic icon vocabulary.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups this item is visible to. Empty means everyone.

hideBeforeLogin.title: Hide before login
hideBeforeLogin.description: Hide this item from visitors with no session.

hideAfterLogin.title: Hide after login
hideAfterLogin.description: Hide this item from visitors who are signed in.

items.title: Sub-items
items.description: One level of sub-items. A sub-item MUST NOT declare its own `items` — three-level nesting is rejected.

order.title: Order
order.description: Sort order within the parent item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Route or URL this sub-item points at.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon name from the shared semantic icon vocabulary.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups this sub-item is visible to.

hideBeforeLogin.title: Hide before login
hideBeforeLogin.description: Hide from visitors with no session.

hideAfterLogin.title: Hide after login
hideAfterLogin.description: Hide from visitors who are signed in.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The portal this menu belongs to. REQUIRED — an unscoped content object cannot be served, because resolution starts from the site.

page.title: Page
page.description: One page of a portal (ADR-086 §4). Its body is EITHER a widget grid — the same manifest-v2 widget placement OpenBuild authors, on a 12-column grid — OR markdown, stored and served as source so a Docusaurus build consumes it with no HTML round-trip. The two are not a hierarchy: a landing page is grid-first, a documentation page is markdown-first, and both are pages.

title.title: Title
title.description: Page title, used as the heading and the document title.

route.title: Route
route.description: In-portal path this page is served at, leading slash included. Unique within a portal.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status. An unpublished page is not served, and its absence is indistinguishable from a route that does not exist — no existence oracle.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale of this page's content. Part of the content cache key.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Short description used for listings, search results and the page's meta description.
summary.example: Wie wij zijn en waar wij voor staan.

body.title: Body
body.description: The page content. Exactly one of `markdown` or `widgets` is meaningful, selected by `type`.

type.title: Body type
type.description: Which body this page carries. `grid` places widgets on the shared 12-column manifest grid; `markdown` holds prose.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown SOURCE for a markdown body. Served as source, never converted to HTML by the API — a consumer that renders markdown itself needs no parsing step, and no fidelity is lost to a round-trip.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.description: Widget placements for a grid body, in the canonical manifest-v2 widgetEntry shape. gridX + gridWidth must not exceed 12 — a constraint JSON Schema cannot express over siblings, enforced at render time with the existing canonical message.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable kebab-case identity for this placement.

widgetKey.title: Widget key
widgetKey.description: Registry key identifying the widget component. Resolved against nc-vue's communal dashboardWidgetRegistry — the SAME catalog LaunchPad and OpenBuild consume. Only entries flagged public render at a public origin; anything else renders an inert placeholder.

gridWidth.title: Grid width
gridWidth.description: Width in grid columns, of twelve.

props.title: Props
props.description: Serialisable configuration handed to the widget.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The portal this page belongs to. REQUIRED — content is always resolved within a site.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: One portal Portaliq serves (ADR-086 §2). Owns its domains, theme, authentication configuration, locales and publication status. Every menu, page and glossary term belongs to exactly one portal; an Organisation may run several portals (a public site, a supplier portal, a docs site), each branded and authenticated differently. Supersedes the never-implemented white-label-on-Organisation requirement in supplier-portal T08.

title.title: Title
title.description: Display name of the site, shown as the portal header and page title. Replaces the hard-coded literal 'Portaliq' every tenant currently sees.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: One supporting line shown under the portal name in the footer's logo block. The NL Design System reference carries one; without this field every portal's footer showed a bare title.
tagline.example: Één plek voor alle publicaties van de gemeente

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Stable machine identifier for this portal, used to scope content and to address the portal from a consumer that is not resolving by host (a Docusaurus build, a CLI).

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status. Only a published portal is served; a draft lets an editor stage a whole portal without exposing it.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Hostnames this portal answers on. A request is routed by its Host header; an unknown host resolves to NO portal and returns 404 — there is deliberately no default or first-match fallback, because that is exactly how a multi-tenant host serves one tenant's content under another tenant's domain.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: The host this portal answers on, without scheme or port.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether control of the domain has been proven. A domain serves ONLY when true. Without this, pointing DNS at Portaliq would be enough for one tenant to claim another tenant's hostname.

verificationToken.title: Verification token
verificationToken.description: Per-portal nonce the tenant must publish as TXT _portaliq-verify.<hostname>. Per-portal so a record published for one portal cannot verify another.

verifiedAt.title: Verified at
verifiedAt.description: When verification last succeeded. Re-checked periodically; a removed record eventually unbinds the domain.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Reference to a themiq (currently `nldesign`) theme. Portaliq ships NO theming mechanism of its own (ADR-086 §6); an unresolvable reference is reported rather than rendered around.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: URL or object reference for the site logo shown in the portal header.

locales.title: Locales
locales.description: Locales this site publishes content in. The first entry is the default. Part of the content cache key, so a translated page is never served under the wrong locale.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: How visitors to THIS portal authenticate (ADR-086 §8). Absent or unparseable configuration fails closed to public READ-ONLY — never to an authenticated-looking session, and never granting write.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Enabled authentication modes; more than one may be active. `oidc` covers Google, Microsoft and Keycloak through one integration rather than one per provider.

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: eIDAS-aligned assurance floor for the government modes. Absent means low.

oidc.title: OIDC configuration
oidc.description: Provider configuration when `oidc` is enabled: issuer, client id and the scopes requested. The client secret is held in the credential broker, never here.

frameAncestors.title: Frame ancestors
frameAncestors.description: Origins permitted to embed this portal in an iframe, used to build Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors per portal. An empty list forbids framing. This replaces the portal-wide wildcard, which let ANY origin iframe a portal carrying a bearer token.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this portal belongs to. One Organisation may own several portals.

portalAccount.title: Portal Account
portalAccount.description: Links an external identity (eHerkenning / DigiD / eIDAS) to the subject reference used for RBAC scoping. Owned by Portaliq's auth edge; never publicly readable. See ADR-046 and openspec/changes/supplier-portal.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which external audience this account belongs to. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — e.g. supplier, client, citizen, organisation, student, parent, external-employee, data-subject, signer, participant, vendor-org. Not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

identityType.title: Identity type
identityType.description: The external identity provider that authenticated this account. `generic` is a broker-agnostic OIDC provider preset (portal-oidc-broker-login) for a broker that is none of digid/eherkenning/eidas.

identityRef.title: Identity reference
identityRef.description: Pseudonymous identity reference from the IdP (e.g. eHerkenning KvK number for suppliers, or a pairwise pseudonym for clients). Not a raw BSN.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The reference the domain apps scope their data by (e.g. procest supplierRef). Server-derived; never accepted from the client.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant (OpenRegister Organisation) this account belongs to.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Human-readable name for the portal UI.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email for notifications (masked in logs).

needsAlternativeContact.title: Needs alternative contact
needsAlternativeContact.description: portal-notifications-dispatch (WMEBV notificatieplicht fallback, ~Awb 2:11): set true by NotificationDispatchJob after N consecutive failed out-of-band notification attempts for this account — signals an operator must reach the subject by another channel. Reset to false on the next successful dispatch.

lastLoginAt.title: Last login at
lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Server-managed per-app claim map linking this account to domain identities: {appId: {claimName: uuid}} (ADR-046 contract v2, A4). Written only by Portaliq server code / admin tooling — never accepted from a client. Collections select a claim via scopeClaim.

portalAuditEntry.title: Portal Audit Entry
portalAuditEntry.description: Append-only, portal-owned audit-trail fact record (portal-session-hardening-v2): written on every portal mutation (create/update/forward), every download, and every session event (login/logout/refresh). Never carries payload content — records THAT a verb happened against a target, not the data. Exposed count-only via MetricsController; never publicly readable. Retention is OpenRegister's records-management concern (Archiefwet) — see openspec/changes/portal-session-hardening-v2/design.md.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: The acting/affected session's token id, when known (empty for the download hook, which does not carry one).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject the event belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app recording the entry (defaults to portaliq's own id).

register.title: Target register
register.description: The target register (or, for a forwarded action which touches no register directly, the contributing appId).

schema.title: Target schema
schema.description: The target schema (or, for a forwarded action, the declared action id).

targetId.title: Target id
targetId.description: The target object id (empty for session events and forwarded actions, which have no single object id).

portalMessage.title: Portal Message
portalMessage.description: A message in a subject's portal inbox (the in-portal realisation of the notification/inbox surface). Subject-scoped by subjectRef, so it is read through the same path as any contribution collection. OpenRegister's notification engine (email channel + `field` recipient kind) can additionally email the subject out-of-band when a message arrives.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The recipient subject; the field the inbox is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this message belongs to.

read.title: Read
read.description: Whether the subject has read the message.

nature.title: Aard
nature.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the nature of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when the contributing app supplies it; absent means no such field renders.

rechtsgevolg.title: Rechtsgevolg
rechtsgevolg.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the legal effect of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when supplied.

term.title: Termijn
term.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the deadline associated with the message/decision (e.g. an objection period). Optional — rendered only when supplied.

referenceId.title: Reference id
referenceId.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): the receipt's own reference id, shown to the subject and linked from the matching `portalSubmission` proof-log entry's `receiptMessageRef`. Present only on a receipt message; absent on an ordinary domain notification.

dataCopy.title: Data copy
dataCopy.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): a copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the subject's right to a copy of what they submitted. Present only on a receipt message; never contains a non-whitelisted or raw client field.

taskUuid.title: Task uuid
taskUuid.description: The portal task this message announces (portal-task-delivery). The unified inbox renders a deep link into the "Mijn taken" surface when present; absent means no such link renders.

deliveryUuid.title: Delivery uuid
deliveryUuid.description: The openregister delivery ledger row this message settles (portal-task-delivery). The idempotency key: the worker probes it before writing, so a crash between write and settle never duplicates the message.

portalNotification.title: Portal Notification
portalNotification.description: Append-only per-attempt log of an out-of-band (email) nudge dispatched by NotificationDispatchJob when a contributing app's manifest `notifications` rule key matches a portalMessage create or a successful status transition (portal-notifications-dispatch). One row per attempt — never updated in place — so the burden-of-proof/audit trail is complete. Never publicly readable; recipients are never exposed via metrics.

accountRef.title: Account reference
accountRef.description: The `portalAccount` this notification was dispatched for; the field this log is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this notification belongs to.

ruleKey.title: Rule key
ruleKey.description: The manifest `notifications` rule key that triggered this dispatch (e.g. `message.created`, `status.changed`).

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app whose manifest declared the matched rule key.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The out-of-band channel used. Only `email` is implemented; the field is future-proofed for `sms`/`push`.

status.title: Status
status.description: The outcome of this single attempt.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: The consecutive-failure counter as of this attempt: 0 on `sent`, incremented from the previous attempt's value on `failed`. Reaching the configured threshold flags the account `needsAlternativeContact` (WMEBV notificatieplicht fallback).

portalOidcState.title: Portal OIDC State
portalOidcState.description: Short-lived, single-use server-side storage for one OIDC authorization-code + PKCE round trip (portal-oidc-broker-login). Written by SessionController::oidcStart(), consumed exactly once by SessionController::oidcCallback(); a reused or expired row fails the callback closed. Never publicly readable — it briefly carries the PKCE code_verifier.

state.title: State
state.description: The OIDC `state` parameter — the single-use lookup key for this row (CSRF guard).

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.description: The OIDC `nonce` this authorization request carried; re-checked against the ID token's own `nonce` claim on callback.

codeVerifier.title: PKCE code verifier
codeVerifier.description: The PKCE `code_verifier` presented to the token endpoint on callback, matching the `code_challenge` sent at start.

org.title: Organisation slug
org.description: The `?org=` slug the login was started for.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The provider preset the login was started for.

returnTo.title: Return to
returnTo.description: The portal SPA path to redirect to once the session is minted.

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: When this row becomes unusable — a TTL bound on the whole start→callback round trip, independent of `used`.

used.title: Used
used.description: Set true the moment the row is consumed. A second consumption attempt (state replay) fails closed even if still within `expiresAt`.

portalPage.title: Portal Page
portalPage.description: A data-provisioned portal contribution (ADR-046, portal-page-provisioning). Mirrors the IPortalContributionProvider manifest shape 1:1 so Portaliq's built-in provider can read this object and hand it to the same PortalManifestNormaliser every PHP provider's output passes through. Owned by the app that provisions the page; never publicly readable — the built-in provider is the only reader, server-side.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display name for this contribution in the portal SPA (nav / page title).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which external audience this contribution serves. Open string set (contract v2 A2), same vocabulary as portalAccount.audience — e.g. supplier, client, citizen. Not enum-constrained.

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Contribution-level default minimum trust (low|substantial|high, contract v2 A3). Absent defaults to low. Individual collections/actions may override with their own minTrust. Mutually exclusive with an entry's own `anonymous: true` — the normaliser drops `anonymous` on an entry that also declares a non-low minTrust.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status. Only `active` portalPage objects are read into any aggregate (authenticated or anonymous); `draft` lets an author stage a page without exposing it.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Readable OpenRegister collections this contribution exposes. Each entry mirrors IPortalContributionProvider's collection shape (contract v2/v3).

id.title: Collection id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; referenced by pages[].blocks[].collection.

register.title: Register
register.description: The OpenRegister register slug the collection reads from. A plain string, not an OR object relation — this selects a (register, schema) pair, it does not reference a specific object instance (ADR-062's $ref/format:uuid relation dialect applies to same-register object foreign keys, not cross-register schema selectors).

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema slug within that register.

scopeField.title: Scope field
scopeField.description: The property rows are scoped by (contract v2). Omit or leave absent on an anonymous collection — there is no subject to scope by.

scopeClaim.title: Scope claim
scopeClaim.description: Contract v2 A4: scope by a server-managed portalAccount claim instead of scopeField/subjectRef. Never applicable to an anonymous entry (no portalAccount).

via.title: Via (reverse/forward join)
via.description: Contract v2 A5/A5.2: one-hop join scoping. See the portal-contribution-contract spec for the full shape.

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Overrides the contribution-level minTrust for this collection.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: When true, this collection is included in aggregateAnonymous() and readable with no bearer session. Mutually exclusive with a non-low minTrust on the SAME entry (fail-closed: the normaliser drops anonymous when both are set). Default false.

fields.title: Field projection
fields.description: Read-side whitelist (field-projection change); absent returns the full row.

listable.title: Listable
listable.description: Whether this collection gets a synthesised default page when pages[] is absent.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this collection in the portal SPA (page/nav title when a default page is synthesised, table caption otherwise).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Marks this collection as an INBOX collection (portal-inbox-v2). PortalInboxReader merges every `kind: inbox` collection across the subject's contributions into one sorted inbox, and ContributionController::markRead() refuses to write to a collection that is not one. Omit for an ordinary data collection.

rowActions.title: Row actions
rowActions.description: Ids of `type: update` actions offered per row (contribution-manifest-v3). The normaliser drops any id that does not resolve to an update action on the SAME contribution, so an unresolvable reference is never rendered as a broken control.

defaultSort.title: Default sort
defaultSort.description: Presentation-only default ordering (contribution-manifest-v3): `{ "field": <property>, "direction": "asc"|"desc" }`. Dropped by the normaliser unless `field` is a non-empty string.

direction.title: Sort direction
direction.description: Sort direction; anything else normalises to asc.

filesUpload.title: Files upload
filesUpload.description: Opt IN to the scoped file-upload block (ADR-063). Fail-closed: only an explicit true enables it, and POST /portal/api/collections/{register}/{schema}/{id}/files 404s for a collection that has not declared it. Default false.

filesDownload.title: Files download
filesDownload.description: Opt IN to the scoped file-download block (portal-document-download). Fail-closed on the same terms as filesUpload — a collection that has not declared it 404s with the identical body a missing file returns, so the flag is never an existence oracle. Default false.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Writable/forwardable actions this contribution exposes. Each entry mirrors IPortalContributionProvider's action shape (contract v2/v3), plus the new `anonymous` field.

id.title: Action id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; referenced by pages[].blocks[].action and by POST /portal/api/actions/{appId}/{actionId} for endpoint actions.

type.title: Type
type.description: create/update write through OpenRegister via the portal's own writer; endpoint bearer-forwards to a domain app's own route (contract v2 A6). Anonymous submission is only meaningful for type=create.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this action in the portal SPA (button/form title).

register.title: Register
register.description: Target register for create/update. Plain string schema-selector, not an OR relation — see the collections.register note.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Target schema slug within that register.

fields.title: Field whitelist
fields.description: The ONLY client-supplied fields accepted; anything else in the request body is dropped server-side.

set.title: Server-forced values
set.description: Values the server stamps AFTER the whitelist, never client-choosable (e.g. a fixed status transition target).

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Values stamped over the whitelisted payload server-side (e.g. a supertype discriminator). Applied after the whitelist so a client can never override them.

endpoint.title: Endpoint path
endpoint.description: Instance-local absolute path for type=endpoint (contract v2 A6). Full URLs are rejected (SSRF guard).

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Overrides the contribution-level minTrust for this action.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: When true and type=create, this action is reachable via POST /portal/api/collections/{register}/{schema} with NO bearer session — the write is unowned (no subjectRef/organisation stamped). Mutually exclusive with a non-low minTrust on the SAME entry (fail-closed: the normaliser drops anonymous when both are set, falling back to requiring authentication). Default false.

submitLabel.title: Submit label
submitLabel.description: Label on the form's submit button (contribution-manifest-v3); falls back to `label` when absent.

successMessage.title: Success message
successMessage.description: Confirmation shown after a successful submission (contribution-manifest-v3).

fieldConfigs.title: Field configs
fieldConfigs.description: Per-field presentation hints (label / required / size / placeholder), keyed by property name (contribution-manifest-v3). The normaliser keeps ONLY keys that also appear in this action's `fields` whitelist, so a config can never widen what the server accepts.

optionsProviders.title: Options providers
optionsProviders.description: Per-field value sources for select inputs, keyed by property name (contribution-manifest-v3). Each provider declares a `type` from the normaliser's allowed provider kinds; an unrecognised kind is dropped rather than rendered.

notifications.title: Notification rule keys
notifications.description: Per-rule-key OPT IN to out-of-band notification email (portal-notifications-dispatch, ADR-046). NotificationDispatchService only dispatches for a trigger whose rule key appears here, so a page declaring neither key gets no email at all (fail-closed). Currently `message.created` and `status.changed`.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Explicit UI page composition (contribution-manifest-v3). Absent synthesises one default page per listable collection.

id.title: Page id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; the portal SPA's page route segment.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this page in the portal SPA (nav item / page title).

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: An MDI name resolvable by the shared icon registry.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Ordered UI blocks composing the page. type ∈ collection|action|detail|richText|cta (PortalManifestNormaliser::BLOCK_TYPES) — an unrecognised type or an unresolvable collection/action reference is dropped by the normaliser, never rendered as broken.

type.title: Block type
type.description: The block's kind — which of the below reference fields applies, and how the SPA renders it (PortalManifestNormaliser::BLOCK_TYPES).

portalSession.title: Portal Session
portalSession.description: A bearer session issued by Portaliq's auth edge. Records the minted token id (jti) so sessions can be revoked. Owned by Portaliq; never publicly readable.

accountRef.title: Account reference
accountRef.description: Reference to the portalAccount this session was issued for.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject reference carried in the token (server-derived).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: The external audience of this session. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this session is scoped to.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: Unique token identifier (JWT jti claim) for revocation.

trustLevel.title: Trust level
trustLevel.description: Assurance level of the authentication (e.g. eHerkenning EH3, DigiD Midden/Substantieel).

authTime.title: Origin authentication time
authTime.description: The ORIGINAL login this session descends from (portal-session-hardening-v2). Carried unchanged across every refresh rotation, so it records when the subject actually authenticated rather than when the current token was minted — `issuedAt` moves on each rotation, this does not. PortalSessionService has always written it; until schema 0.3.0 it was not declared here, so OpenRegister's MagicMapper discarded it on every single session mint and the stored row silently lost the origin timestamp.

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Whether the session has been explicitly revoked (logout / admin).

portalSubmission.title: Portal Submission
portalSubmission.description: Append-only proof-of-receipt log record satisfying the WMEBV burden-of-proof duty (~Awb 2:25): one row per successful portal create-action, linking to the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` it generated. Subject- and tenant-scoped like any other portal object; backs the subject's right to a copy of their own submission-log entries. See openspec/specs/supplier-portal/spec.md (wmebv-submission-receipts).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The submitting subject; the field this log is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this submission belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app whose `type: create` action was submitted.

actionId.title: Action id
actionId.description: The declared action id that was submitted.

payloadCopy.title: Payload copy
payloadCopy.description: A copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the same map the domain create persisted, never the raw client body.

receiptMessageRef.title: Receipt message reference
receiptMessageRef.description: Links to the `referenceId` of the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` this submission generated.

deliveryStatus.title: Delivery status
deliveryStatus.description: The receipt's retriability signal: `delivered` once the receipt message was written, `failed` when the receipt/log side-effect threw (retriable — the domain create itself is never lost).

portalTrafficEvent.title: Portal Traffic Event
portalTrafficEvent.description: One accepted traffic event, written by the collector through OpenRegister's raw append path and deleted once it passes the portal's retention window. Carries no IP address and no raw user agent: the visitor is a salted daily hash, and device, browser and region are derived in the request and the source discarded. Readable by instance admins only; reports read the daily aggregates instead.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The slug of the portal this event belongs to.

name.title: Event name
name.description: The event, in the GA4 spelling.

occurredAt.title: Occurred at
occurredAt.description: When the client says the event happened, clamped to the server clock.

receivedAt.title: Received at
receivedAt.description: When the collector accepted the event.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: The event's position within its session, as the client counted it. Journeys are ordered by this, never by arrival.

visitorHash.title: Visitor hash
visitorHash.description: A salted hash of the day, the portal, the address and the user agent. The salt rotates daily and is not kept, so the hash cannot be reversed and does not survive the day.

clientId.title: Client id
clientId.description: The browser-stored identifier, present only when the portal persists a client id and the visitor consented.

sessionId.title: Session id
sessionId.description: The client's session identifier when it keeps one; empty in cookieless mode, where aggregation derives sessions.

pageLocation.title: Page location
pageLocation.description: The full URL the event happened on, truncated to 512 characters.

pagePath.title: Page path
pagePath.description: The path only, with the query string removed after campaign parameters were parsed out of it.

pageReferrer.title: Referrer
pageReferrer.description: The page the visitor came from, when the portal keeps it.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The acquisition channel derived from the referrer and campaign parameters.

pageTitle.title: Page title
pageTitle.description: The document title, when the portal keeps it.

deviceType.title: Device type
deviceType.description: Derived from the user agent, which is then discarded.

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: The browser family, without a version.

os.title: Operating system
os.description: The operating system family, without a version.

language.title: Language
language.description: The visitor's first accepted language, as a two-letter code.

region.title: Region
region.description: A country or region code, no finer than the portal allows. Empty when the portal stores no location.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: The viewport bucket the client reported.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: What the visitor searched for. Only kept when the portal enabled the dimension.

linkUrl.title: Link URL
linkUrl.description: The outbound link that was clicked.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The campaign name from utm_campaign or mtm_campaign, or carried by a mail event.

source.title: Source
source.description: The traffic source from utm_source or mtm_source.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: The medium from utm_medium or mtm_medium.

content.title: Content
content.description: The content variant from utm_content or mtm_content.

term.title: Term
term.description: The paid keyword from utm_term or mtm_kwd.

blastRef.title: Blast reference
blastRef.description: The sending app's mailing identifier, on mail events only.

contactRef.title: Contact reference
contactRef.description: The sending app's pseudonymous contact identifier, on mail events only.

userRef.title: User reference
userRef.description: The signed-in portal user's reference. Only present when the portal switched on account linking.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: A bounded map of extra values the client attached: at most 20 keys, scalar values, 256 characters each.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: The visitor's consent state as the client knew it when the event was sent.

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: When this event is deleted: received at plus the portal's retention period.

portalTrafficDaily.title: Portal Traffic Daily
portalTrafficDaily.description: One portal's traffic for one UTC day, recomputed from the raw events by the aggregation job every fifteen minutes. Contains counts only, never a visitor. The Traffic page and any export read these records through the ordinary object API.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.description: Distinct visitors that day, by daily hash or client id.

newVisitors.title: New visitors
newVisitors.description: Visitors with a persisted client id whose client reported its first session that day. Null in cookieless mode: a daily hash cannot say whether it was here yesterday, and a zero would claim it can.

returningVisitors.title: Returning visitors
returningVisitors.description: Visitors with a persisted client id whose client reported a returning session that day. Null in cookieless mode, never zero.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Distinct signed-in portal accounts seen that day. Only counted when the portal switched on account linking; null otherwise.

engagedSessions.title: Engaged sessions
engagedSessions.description: Sessions with more than one page view, a scroll, or at least ten seconds between events.

avgEngagementSeconds.title: Average engagement (seconds)
avgEngagementSeconds.description: Mean seconds between a session's first and last event.

bounceRate.title: Bounce rate
bounceRate.description: The share of sessions that were not engaged, between 0 and 1.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Per-path views, entrances, exits and engagement.

views.title: Views
views.description: Page views of this path that day.

entrances.title: Entrances
entrances.description: Sessions that started on this path.

exits.title: Exits
exits.description: Sessions that ended on this path.

avgEngagementSeconds.title: Average engagement (seconds)
avgEngagementSeconds.description: Mean seconds on this path before the next page view.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.description: How often visitors moved from one path to the next within a session.

from.title: From
from.description: The path the visitor came from.

to.title: To
to.description: The path the visitor went to.

count.title: Count
count.description: How often this step was taken.

referrers.title: Referrers
referrers.description: Sessions per referring host and channel.

host.title: Host
host.description: The referring host, empty for a direct visit.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel derived from the referrer: organic search, referral, social, email or direct.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Sessions per campaign, source and medium.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The campaign name from utm_campaign or a mail blast.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source, such as newsletter or google.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: The medium, such as email or cpc.

searches.title: Searches
searches.description: Search terms and their counts. Only when the portal keeps search terms.

outbound.title: Outbound links
outbound.description: Outbound links clicked and their counts.

url.title: URL
url.description: The outbound link that was followed.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Goal conversions. Reserved for a later phase.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: The goal name. Reserved for a later phase.

conversions.title: Conversions
conversions.description: How often the goal was reached.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Mail opens and clicks attributed to this portal by another app in the instance.

opens.title: Opens
opens.description: Mail opens attributed to this portal by another app.

clicks.title: Clicks
clicks.description: Mail clicks attributed to this portal by another app.

aggregatedAt.title: Aggregated at
aggregatedAt.description: When this record was last recomputed.

lastEventAt.title: Last event at
lastEventAt.description: The newest event that went into this record.
